user.title: Set up ha Godox BLE Mesh

menu_options.manual: Enter network key and app key manually

import.title: Import the Godox app's mesh export
import.description: Paste the whole `meshJson` export from the Godox app's own database here (see the project README's "How the keys were found" section) -- the network key, app key, and every Godox light's name and address are picked up automatically, no hex or decimal typing needed.

select_lights.title: Choose which lights to add
select_lights.description: These are the Godox lights found in the export. You can add more later from Configure.

manual.title: Godox mesh network keys
manual.description: Paste the network key and app key pulled from the Godox app's own database (see the project README's "How the keys were found" section). Pick a provisioner address this installation hasn't used before -- different from the Godox app's own address (0x0100 / 256) and from any other controller (another Home Assistant instance, the project's own `godox_mesh.py` script, etc.) on the same mesh.

error.no_light_found: No light on this mesh answered. Close the Godox app and any other tool connected to it, make sure a light is powered on and in range, then try again.
error.import_not_json: That isn't valid JSON -- paste the whole mesh export, unedited.
error.import_missing_keys: That JSON doesn't have the expected netKeys/appKeys fields -- make sure it's the full mesh export, not a partial copy.
error.import_no_lights: No Godox lights (company id 0211) were found in that export.
error.import_invalid: Couldn't read that as a Godox mesh export.

abort.already_configured: This mesh network is already configured.
